strategy.overview: ROCs turns the lower playfield into a survival screen. Shoot the approaching ROCs before they reach the power source, use side-target lasers and displayed power-ups to clear crowded waves, and protect flipper strength. After the screen is clear, shoot the raised scoop to enter the next level.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot every ROC before it reaches the power source. Use the side targets to fire lasers, collect displayed power-ups, then shoot the raised scoop after the screen is clear to start the next level.
strategy.summary: Destroy the approaching ROCs, using side-target lasers and power-ups before they damage the power source and weaken the flippers. Clear the screen, then shoot the raised scoop to advance.

quickInfo.name: ROCs
quickInfo.summary: Hit the on-screen rocks before they cross the playfield and reach the power source. Large ROCs split into smaller ones.

quickInfo.name: Lasers
quickInfo.summary: Hit the side targets to fire across the screen and remove threats that are difficult to reach directly.

quickInfo.name: Power source
quickInfo.summary: ROCs that break through cause damage and reduce flipper strength, making the wave harder to recover.

quickInfo.name: Next level
quickInfo.summary: Once the screen is clear, shoot the raised scoop indicated by the game to continue.

steps.text: Aim physical shots through the on-screen ROCs before they reach the protected power source.
When a large ROC splits, clear the smaller pieces before returning to threats that remain far from the power source.
Use the side targets to fire lasers across crowded parts of the screen, and collect the displayed power-up shots when offered.
Protect the power source: each breach can damage the flippers and make them weaker.
After no ROCs remain, shoot the raised scoop shown by the game to begin the next level.
Preserve flipper power by clearing the nearest threats first.
Save lasers and power-up opportunities for split ROCs or a crowded screen.
Repeat the clear-and-scoop sequence as the levels become faster and denser.

cautions.issue: ROCs works with every P3 upper module.
cautions.response: Use the live screen and raised scoop indicator; the useful physical shot can change with the installed module.
